notes.subject: to Pharaoh
notes.rationale: Continuation of Moses' direct speech to Pharaoh, all 'bilong yu' forms.

notes.subject: ממך ומבתיך... ומעבדיך ומעמך
notes.rationale: fourfold 'mi-/' (from) chain reversed from v.5 order (servants/people → houses/servants/people), a chiasm-like reversal lost in translation.

translation: Na ol frok bai lus long yu, na long ol haus bilong yu, na long ol wokman bilong yu, na long ol manmeri bilong yu; tasol long wara ol bai stap.
